mapper.select: SELECT @rank := @rank + 1 AS `rank`, t.storeId, t.storeName, t.orderCount FROM ( SELECT s.id AS storeId, s.store_name AS storeName, COUNT(a.id) AS orderCount FROM after_sale_order a JOIN store_info s ON a.store_id = s.id WHERE a.created_at >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') GROUP BY s.id, s.store_name ORDER BY orderCount DESC LIMIT 10 ) t CROSS JOIN (SELECT @rank := 0) r ORDER BY t.orderCount DESC
SELECT DATE(created_at) AS `date`, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM after_sale_order WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY `date`

SELECT DATE(ai_audit_time) AS `date`, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM after_sale_order WHERE ai_audit_status = 1 AND ai_audit_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(ai_audit_time) ORDER BY `date`

SELECT DATE(ai_audit_time) AS `date`, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM after_sale_order WHERE ticket_status = 2 AND ai_audit_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(ai_audit_time) ORDER BY `date`
